name: Log Injection / Forging
attack_scenario: an attacker puts CR/LF plus a forged line into a logged field (e.g. username), injecting fake entries that mislead responders or poison log-driven dashboards
negative_test_hint: set username to a value containing \r\n and a forged 'admin logged in' line; assert the log has no injected newline

exemplar.compliant:
safe = username.replace("\r", " ").replace("\n", " ")
logger.warning("failed login for %s", safe)
exemplar.explanation: strip CR/LF from user-controlled values before logging (or pass them as structured params, not into the format string)
